label: Raspberry
user_direction: Work backward from the richer original Raspberry finish and preserve its branched clusters, large textured berries and white blossom.

original_final_reference.frame_hash_encoding: raw RGBA pixels; not PNG file bytes

final_preservation.method: Reference-faithful native reconstruction of the richer original finish.
final_preservation.retained_character: Asymmetric branched serrated foliage, seven large drupelet-textured raspberries (left3/right4), one clear white crown blossom and green buds, split bean and shallow soil ring.
final_preservation.boundary: Original provenance does not imply identical artwork. Source-pose identity and prepared/runtime pixels are checked separately.

astra_review.boundary: Independent visual inspection of all25 static poses and all24 adjacent transitions in both opaque148px approximate-renderer themes, plus native256px atlas and focused neighbor board. This does not establish actual Compose rendering or live playback smoothness.

inventory.fruit: Seven identifiable persistent sites from F10 onward, L3/R4; green buds become textured aggregate berries and ripen in place.
inventory.flower: One open white upper-left crown flower from F12 through F25; no repaired flower reclosure.
inventory.base: Broad split brown bean and soil ring stay similarly sized and registered throughout.

astra_review.target_similarity: The final reconstructs the original's asymmetric leafy cane, seven large conical/aggregate raspberries, white crown flower and broad bean/soil ring. It restores mature abundance and recognizable raspberry texture. It is reference-faithful reconstruction, not an exact copy of the historical final pixels.

repair_assessment.early_bridge: F7-F9 now stage upper leaves, branches and fruiting buds before the fuller F10 canopy. Established lower leaves/cane persist; no meaningful early reset remains.
repair_assessment.flower_poses: F14/F15/F19 retain all seven berries and the open white flower. F13->F14 and F18->F19 have a slightly lower/tighter crown and altered leaf/flower placement. Focused native-size inspection does not show a meaningful berry-size reversal; berries remain comparable or plumper. Base width alone was not used as proof of canopy continuity.
repair_assessment.late_growth: Ripening proceeds forward across retained fruit; all seven exist well before the final row. F21-F24 still develop the right-side colors; F24->F25 is one quiet mature settling transition.

residuals.issue: Small crown height, leaf placement and flower placement shifts from native whole-pose repairs are visible at source size and subtly at148px. They do not read as fruit deletion, replanting or meaningful growth reversal.
A fuller canopy/bud step and slight painted-material difference remain at the bridge-to-bank join, now supported by preceding branch development.
Subtle swelling/maturation changes; late motion is deliberately quieter after the main color payoff.

astra_review.alpha_assessment: No material bright-green fringe or missing-alpha surface is apparent on either opaque148px theme contact; raw transparent RGB noise was not treated as a visible defect.

independent_astra_review.method: Independently inspected all25 poses and24 adjacent transitions in both148px opaque theme contacts and full prepared atlas against the original final reference. Read nested curation records and verified all22 non-bridge source cells equal the reviewed flower selection.

counts_and_persistence.early_growth: Bean germination grows into retained lateral leaves, then additional crown foliage and curved fruit-bearing branches. No definite leaf deletion or whole-plant reset remains in the final early sequence.
counts_and_persistence.fruit: Bud positions develop throughF9–11; seven identifiable textured berries (left3/right4) are clear fromF12 and remain throughF25. Fruit enlarge/ripen in place; no final count insertion.
counts_and_persistence.flower: One open white crown flower persistsF12–25. The previous F14/F15/F19 closure reversals are resolved. Green crown buds remain part of the target composition.
counts_and_persistence.color: No observed ripe/pink fruit returns to green. Left then right groups ripen, with lower-right finishing acrossF22–24.

independent_astra_review.growth_bridge_seams: F6→7→8→9→10 now distributes leafy expansion and truss/bud arrival across several stages. F8→9 still develops branches briskly, but F9 provides a visible younger bud-bearing version ofF10 rather than jumping directly from sparse four-leaf plant to mature canopy. Bean/soil proportions remain coherent.
independent_astra_review.flower_repair_seams: F13→14→15→16 andF18→19→20 retain all seven berries, open white flower and stable base. Repaired poses have minor leaf fullness, berry contour and flower-position differences. At148px these read as small native-paint variations, without changed anatomy or material identity. F15 bean angle variation is minor.
independent_astra_review.original_target_fidelity: Restores the richer original identity: asymmetric fuller branches, seven large drupelet-textured berries, serrated layered foliage, one white blossom and green buds above the split bean/soil ring. Exact branch angles, individual leaf shapes and original pixels differ; accept as reference-faithful native reconstruction.
residuals: Small native whole-pose paint/contour variation at flower replacement joins.
One quiet final settling frame after ordered late ripening.

Reviewer used saved files only and did not operate the device.

native_capture_checks.preview_finish_comparisons: Parent validation reports two exact matches; this review visually confirms the shown finish, without independently recomputing those two comparisons.

findings: Actual Compose rendering agrees with the selected static review; no new clipping, visible alpha defect or rendering regression.
Seven L3/R4 fruiting sites persist from F10 through F25, growing into clearly aggregate raspberries with forward ripening.
White crown flower stays open F12-F25, including native repaired F14/F15/F19.
Early F7-F9 bridge stages leaves and lateral fruiting branches before the fuller F10 state; no meaningful leaf loss or replanting.
F13->F14 and F18->F19 show small crown/leaf placement variation, not meaningful berry shrink. Bean/soil registration and scale remain coherent.

Final finish preserves the original reference intent: rich asymmetric seven-berry cane, serrated leafy foliage, white flower, broad split bean and soil ring; it is a reconstruction, not historical pixel reuse.

Subtle swelling/maturation changes; late motion is deliberately quieter after the main color payoff.
